title: Evaluation equivalence of units stalks for arbitrary algebraically closed overfields
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $K^s$ its separable closure, and $\Omega$ an algebraically closed field containing $K^s$ in a compatible $K$-tower [def-pc-field-extension], [def-pd-separable-closure]. Let $p$ be the corresponding geometric point of $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and let $\mathbf G_m$ be its additive units sheaf [def-sc-gm-torsor]. There is an additive equivalence $e:(\mathbf G_m)_p\simeq\operatorname{Additive}((K^s)^\times)$ whose value on every germ, embedded into $\Omega$, is evaluation of its section along its geometric lift, with the canonical global-sections isomorphism of Spec Omega and removal of ULift. No sheaf-representation equivalence or Galois-action datum is assumed.

proof.text: The private proved helper factors a geometric lift through its image residue field. The source etale residue-field map theorem, and the isomorphism between Spec K and its residue-field spectrum, make that extension separable. The factorization is K-linear. Evaluation naturality and IsSeparable.map show every evaluated function is separable over K; this works for arbitrary Omega.

Corestrict the given embedding Ks -> Omega to the relative separable closure of K in Omega. Both domain and codomain are separable closures, so Mathlib Algebra.IsAlgebraic.algHom_bijective2 (Lean algHom_bijective₂) makes this homomorphism bijective, using IsSepClosed.lift in the reverse direction. Invert it. Compose evaluation into the relative closure with this inverse, apply Units.map, Additive and ULift. Pullback compatibility and embedding injectivity give a compatible cocone. Use presheafFiberDesc and ULift.down to obtain an additive map, and its cocone identity for the displayed germ formula.
Apply the independent bijectivity theorem to the constructed map and its germ formula; AddEquiv.ofBijective gives the equivalence with the same evaluation formula.
